note: Primary descriptions of T4NDD highlight ID, behavioral issues, and subtle facial dysmorphisms rather than major structural malformations, making this hypothesis plausible.

evidence.text: In the initial cohort of eight individuals with de novo putative loss-of-function variants in TAF4 (T4NDD), the canonical phenotype comprised intellectual disability, abnormal behavior, and facial dysmorphisms without highlighting major internal organ or cranial structural malformations.

source.title: De novo putative loss‐of‐function variants in TAF4 are associated with a neuro‐developmental disorder
source.quote: We here present a cohort of eight individuals, each carrying de novo putative loss-of-function (pLoF) variants in TAF4 and expressing phenotypes consistent with a neuro-developmental disorder (NDD). Common features include intellectual disability, abnormal behavior, and facial dysmorphisms.
